study.question: With the stronger joint forward model and true-label transfer geometry retained, does learning auxiliary private modules from correctly assigned labels contribute to the fixed-common source transfer, beyond the generic effects of private optimization?
study.hypothesis: The fixed-common bit has no explicit current-label input at a fixed network state, but its recipient Jacobians and native true-label radius are generated by auxiliary modules learned on correctly assigned labels. Replacing only auxiliary private-update targets by cycled label tuples should attenuate the positive-sign advantage or change its sign interaction if that learned state is consequential. This is a conditional private-learning intervention, not removal of all auxiliary label information. Existing equality of factored and difference arithmetic does not establish tensor equality or a mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local parent source and receipt read; retain forward/model/bit arithmetic. Separate native true-label context geometry from auxiliary private targets using ten identity edges, then cross private target assignment with external sign.

Earlier label-reassignment negative control changed both private learning and ordinary auxiliary shared gradients. The proposed surrogate retains an explicitly computed true-label geometry rule while changing private learning; it still cannot hold geometry trajectories fixed.

Archived primary text lines56-110 describes target-conditioned local-activation history pooling. That forward inheritance is unchanged; the intervention concerns auxiliary private learning and a declared surrogate VJP. No exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Pinned benchmark primary source forward lines123-170 uses task-masked sequence hubs and task-token prediction. This study keeps the inherited forward architecture fixed and changes backward ownership. Benchmark code is not evidence of original-paper equivalence or local effectiveness.

Cached benchmark section2.3 is a primary source for its own model taxonomy, not full original-method audits. Replacing forward token/hub/mixing architecture would confound the present private-learning contrast. Closest gradient-optimization literature was not available in the authorized search results; global novelty remains unverified.

inherited_components: Entire forward representation, embeddings, target/history compression, match and position moments, Dice normalization, residual adapters, low-rank context/history products and four task towers from g3-r0076-factored_positive.
All FP64 row-space geometry helpers, native true-label radius/support, click-relative constraints, canonical fixed-angle line, fixed-common orientation source and external signs.

Training-only all-row cycle shift4097 at B8192 (shift1 for smaller even check batches), true and alternate-label BCE families, factored and difference source VJPs, and finite zero-value surrogate convention.
Frozen host data, source boundaries, labels, scoring, optimizer recipe and resource/holdout contracts.
study.proposed_difference: Expand the seven collected context outputs to ten: click, three auxiliary private forward edges, three true-geometry surrogate edges, and three fixed-common bit-source surrogate edges. Compute true auxiliary context VJPs explicitly with autograd.grad in every arm; discard natural private-edge cotangents at the shared-context boundary. Inject detached true-geometry and factored-bit VJPs on their respective edges. Only auxiliary PRIVATE parameter losses select true versus cycled training labels. Cross that selection with aligned versus reversed external orientation. All four cells execute identical forward/state work and three VJP traversals; no capacity change or extra forward. Returned training scalar is the selected private objective plus finite exact-zero surrogates, and is explicitly not the potential whose ordinary gradient equals the shared surrogate update.
predictions: Validity first: private_true_positive_bridge should reproduce g3-r0076-factored_positive AUC0.6688371501765777, and private_true_negative_bridge should reproduce g3-r0076-factored_negative AUC0.6682863175723434, each within1e-6. Failure blocks claims of faithful lineage.
Predeclared primary contrast Delta_plus=AUC(true,+)-AUC(cycle,+). Prediction: Delta_plus>=0.0001 if informative auxiliary private learning contributes to the favorable fixed-common trajectory.

Predeclared interaction D=[AUC(true,+)-AUC(true,-)]-[AUC(cycle,+)-AUC(cycle,-)]. Prediction: D>=0.0002 if private semantic learning contributes to the inherited sign separation (~0.000550833). Treat these as practical thresholds, not significance tests.

At identical initial state and inputs, changing private target selection must leave forward predictions, true-geometry VJPs, bit-source VJPs and the pre-optimizer shared-context VJP unchanged for each external sign, while changing auxiliary private gradients. A change before private optimization invalidates the intended boundary.

Auxiliary validation quality may fall with reassigned private labels. That diagnoses intervention strength; it is not evidence for or against the click-transfer mechanism by itself. All costs and all four true-label metrics must be reported.
falsifiers: If valid cycle-positive performance matches/exceeds true-positive within0.0001 AND the sign interaction magnitude is below0.0001, the predicted practical dependence on correctly assigned private labels is unsupported at the frozen seed.

An interaction of the opposite direction contradicts the predicted attenuation; retain it as counterevidence and consider private-label learning harmful or a different mechanism, rather than selecting only the best cell.

Any private-label-dependent shared VJP difference at fixed state before the optimizer, private gradients from an injected geometry/source VJP, altered forward/state/capacity, nonfinite gradients or masking failure invalidates implementation attribution.

If either true-label bridge misses its parent by more than1e-6, do not interpret the cycled arms as controlled follow-ups to round76. Diagnose the collection arithmetic first; do not automatically rerun.

Even a positive Delta_plus or D alone does not establish a bit-specific mechanism; changes in native radius/support and dense clipping remain competing explanations. Without authorized diagnostics those explanations stay unresolved.
alternative_explanations: Reassigned auxiliary labels change private parameters and consequently BOTH native true-label geometry and the fixed-common source Jacobians over training. This contrast does not isolate the orientation bit alone.
Auxiliary labels remain in native geometry/radius/support in every arm. A surviving benefit cannot establish label-free learning or dispensability of auxiliary supervision.
Frozen global dense gradient clipping can couple auxiliary private-gradient norms to click updates; changing the host clipping rule is prohibited.
The deterministic batch cycle preserves marginal and joint auxiliary tuple counts but is not an independent-label draw; user repetition and ordering can preserve correlations.
The new explicit geometry VJP may change floating-point accumulation. True-label bridges must pass before attributing differences to label assignment.
One frozen seed and many adaptively selected validation contrasts; deterministic replays are not independent random initializations. No statistical significance or holdout generalization follows.

observations.statement: Factored and difference expressions yielded identical click AUCs for each sign:0.6688371501765777 aligned and0.6682863175723434 reversed. This is numerical equality of reported AUC, not measured source-VJP or bit equality. Candidate diagnostics were not requested.

Pooled- and fixed-common source positives were0.6688439850318495 and0.6688371501765777, while negatives were0.6680225598277424 and0.6682863175723434. Similar favorable-sign quality does not show prevalence invariance of gradients or negative trajectories.

Early joint0.668457307890924 exceeded click-only and context-blocked0.6678548720585206; global auxiliary label roll0.6674639465810746 was worse. This negative branch motivates a narrower private-only replacement with true-label geometry retained. It is not evidence that label assignment in the fixed-common bit itself explains later gains.

validation_plan.phase: propose; no training, installation, torch import or holdout evaluation performed in the coding environment.
completed_static_checks: Parsed and compiled all four standalone modules using Python AST/builtin compile; imports are unchanged from the accepted parent and no filesystem/network operations were introduced in model code.

Verified baseline_reference.py SHA256=f4b473cbacf60d72cff90f3721ad754dd617ee6065fe3fca2fc9cd4be2b25c36 and parent SHA256=1d314809d9883f251f7bb58c76d1ac818e5cd7813ab097ebecde44688d0e2a2e against accepted receipts.

Executable AST equality (excluding documentation): every inherited top-level helper is unchanged; every Model method except __init__/training_loss is unchanged, including forward/history masking. All inherited construction/initialization calls retain their expressions/order. Source-helper documentation now distinguishes the selected private objective from retained true-label geometry.

AST check: exactly three autograd.grad traversals per module, all create_graph=False, and geometry/source injection uses detached VJPs. Config choices and constructor defaults agree; only target assignment and external sign differ across cells.
required_host_preflight: Using the authorized host interface only, compare aligned and reversed true-label bridges against their accepted round76 models from identical state. Check forward outputs, all Dice state updates, selected scalar loss, private parameter gradients and shared context/embedding gradients, including dtype/cast behavior before and after repeated-ID scatter.

At identical state, true versus cycle selectors must give identical forward, true-geometry, factored-bit and pre-optimizer shared gradients for each sign; private auxiliary gradients must match direct gradients of the selected target BCE, and injected VJPs must add no private parameter gradients.

Exercise ordinary and repeated categorical IDs, B2/small even batches and B8192; all-empty, one occupied, mixed and full histories; all-zero auxiliary labels and positive tuples; nonfinite rejection; zero/near-zero tangents and pivot ties. Reassigned target tuples must preserve auxiliary marginal/joint counts across ALL rows; current click labels never change and historical actions/masks remain identical.

Verify exactly32192421 parameters and identical state_dict shapes; no extra forward/BN update or RNG draw. Confirm cache cleared after training_loss and every eval forward; evaluation needs no current labels and permits the frozen final validation remainder.

All checks consume the research budget. Host tensor/preflight tooling is not exposed in this coding environment; these are pending requirements, not claimed passes. If the host cannot perform a required ownership check, report the limitation rather than assert mechanism validity.
validation_plan.full_unit_bridge_gate: Within1e-6 AUC of the matching round76 sign is required; then analyze the contemporaneous factorial, not a candidate-versus-historical-only comparison.
validation_plan.reporting: Report all four cells, private training objective definition, full validation counts, per-task AUC/logloss, click/logloss contrasts, measured parameters, GPU/wall seconds, examples processed, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95. Prespecified inherited history slices:empty,1-16,17-64,>64; report positive/negative counts and insufficient bins. No arbitrary new slices or independence claims. Equal work/passes do not imply equal measured compute.
validation_plan.diagnostic_limits: No authorized live gradient-probe or prediction-export interface is exposed here; previous candidate_diagnostics are not_requested. Same-state host checks are necessary boundaries; bit disagreement, native-radius/support trajectories, dense clipping rates and user-cluster intervals remain unmeasured unless the host explicitly supports and budgets collection. Do not infer these quantities from AUC.
validation_plan.selection_and_holdout: Selection uses full-population validation click AUC only, subject to implementation validity. Freeze candidate/config/source/checkpoint identities, controls, seeds and assessment commands before any separate host-authorized holdout request. No holdout outcomes available or used.
validation_plan.validator_availability: The referenced validate_task.py and jsonschema package are absent from the public workspace. A local standard-library validator checks every constraint in the supplied study_schema; this is not a claimed host-validator pass.

reproduction.interface: The authorized executable experiment interface for this phase is proposal.json variants: the host loads each standalone file, constructs Model(feature_map,**config), runs forward on its frozen filtered inputs, then training_loss(inputs,probabilities,train_labels) before backward under the frozen protocol. No separate training CLI or assessment API was supplied; none is invented.
